messages:
maria: FYI opened a docs PR to update rate limit/quota examples + metering header snippet for the new tiering model. Link: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits/quota-tiering (preview). Can someone review the SDK/curl snippet?

sam: looking now. what's changed in the header shape?

maria: We added `tier` and `allocation_id` to the metering header. New example:

```json
X-Redwood-Metering: {\"account_id\":\"acct_123\",\"tier\":\"pro\",\"allocation_id\":\"alloc_9\"}
```

Also updated the note about per-route vs per-account quotas.

tyler: Heads up: the dashboard metric got renamed yesterday from `requests_per_min` -> `ingest_rps`. Docs panels need to be updated or the screenshots will break. Kevin from billing is aware? @kevin

kevin: yep billing OK. We prefer keeping the old alias for 2 weeks. Add a migration note and mention fallback alias in examples.

sam: I'll add a short migration note and a code snippet that shows backward-compatible header parsing for SDK v2/v3. Proposed curl example:

```bash
curl -H 'X-Redwood-Metering: {"account_id":"acct_123","tier":"pro"}' https://api.redwood.ai/generate
```

should we also add a Python snippet?

maria: yes — please add Python and JS minimal examples. Also fix the broken link in the quota table (it points to /pricing/old-tiers).

jin: docs-bot: preview build started for PR #4521
jin: docs-bot: build succeeded: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4521

sam: quick PR comment left. I also updated the SDK snippet to use `json.dumps` for Python example to avoid escaping problems.

maria: awesome — can someone merge once the preview is green? I'll raise a post-merge note to product Slack about the dashboard metric change so customers aren't surprised.

tyler: I'll handle the product note. +1 to merge once tests pass.

maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
